_comment: Hand-written prose for the action manifest. Kept apart from manifest.json so
regenerating from the GameScript can never destroy it: the generator merges this
in and rewrites the mechanical parts around it.
Every action and parameter here must exist in the GameScript, and every one there
wants an entry here. The drift test enforces both directions.
Describe what the GameScript actually does, checked against its implementation.
A plausible-sounding description inferred from a parameter name is worse than a
missing one: an agent will believe it.
